visualCharacteristics.purpose: White text panel overlapping a full-bleed background photo; stacked below the photo on mobile
visualCharacteristics.description: Text panel layered over a full-bleed image is a side-by-side/overlay layout an author cannot produce with default content.

contentPattern.description: Background image + panel: H2 'Why our ETFs', lead 'Access decades of investment experience...', bold 'Designed with purpose'/'Specialist insight'/'Broader access' each with a paragraph, CTA 'See How We Build Portfolios Designed to Do More'
contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells (either order): image cell (background photo) and text cell (heading, lead paragraph, bold sub-heading + paragraph pairs or lists/links, CTA link as the last link-only paragraph)
rows: H2, lead paragraph, bold sub-heading + paragraph pairs, CTA link

usage.description: Value-proposition or 'why us' panels over a brand photo.

reuseGuidance: Use when one text panel should overlap a full-width photo. For text beside (not over) an image use columns-promo-panel; for a page-opening H1 hero use hero-image-overlay. The paragraph right after the heading renders as the lead, bold-only paragraphs render as sub-headings, and the last link-only paragraph becomes an outlined pill CTA.
